decisions.reason: The source changes how vehicle identification is presented, not whether the existing vehicle-related customer fields remain editable; the current editable field set can support either stated presentation option.
The source specifically changes the vehicle group section and does not require changing or removing vehicle group information from report footers.
The vehicle identification layout refinement is compatible with the retained visual theme and does not change the candidate's design direction or cross-variant consistency.
Vehicle identification presentation is independent of the content and formatting of the front-page result drivers.
The source changes a vehicle identification section, while the internal-header requirement is governed by a separate clause in the same message and already has its corresponding modification.
The vehicle identification display does not alter the required score fields, score heading, prominence, spacing, or visibility of the front-page result summary.
The final-page confidential distribution warning is semantically independent of the vehicle identification section.
Changing the vehicle identification presentation does not alter the scoring table format or its required fields.
The source does not change the required fonts, icons, design assets, or their inclusion in the final package.
The vehicle identification display refinement does not change the DX17–DX20 variant set, editability, or score-based selection rule.
The requested presentation change does not affect the templates' PDF export capability.
The candidate's current state concerns assessment-date placeholder accuracy; duplicating the separately owned vehicle identification presentation rule here is not necessary.
